table.importDescription: Upload a CSV file matching this table's columns. Rows are validated before import.
table.deleteFlaggedDialogDescription: This removes them for good — this cannot be undone. Rows flagged by the assistant stay recoverable (via Restore) until you do this.
table.addTableDescription: Its kind fixes which columns it has. Instances are unlimited — one per card or account, for example.
table.noAccountsYet: No accounts yet — add one in Settings, or create the table now and link it later.
table.noCardsYet: No cards yet — add one in Settings, or create the table now and link it later.
table.noTablesYet: No tables here yet. Create one to start entering data.
